about: « Initiative » smart (proactive agents 3b, passation-pro briefs/design-agents-proactifs.md §3b; bridge-rs/src/offer_ideas.rs). Additions only to contracts/offers: an app 1.0 draws a smart offer as the generic Oui / Non card it already draws (bip_summary, bip_detail under « i »), an app 1.1 draws OfferCard with the lines below.

tool.name: offer_act
tool.smart_only: the free form is listed only for an agent whose level is smart (contracts/proactive); a basic agent's call with `uses` and no `kind` is refused the basic way (« Not done: kind: … »)

free_form.label: ≤ 80, the question
free_form.prompt: ≤ 600, exactly what the agent does at « Oui », shown under « i »
free_form.topic: 1 to 3 words (≤ 40): the card's top line « {agent} propose · {topic} »
free_form.uses: 1 to 6 items, each one of the shapes below, every one checked
free_form.later: the steps that keep their own card

tool.basic_form: kind, label, about, prompt | params, site: as contracts/offers (route, reminder, calendar stay done by the bridge, no model)

uses.tool: <one of its tools now; one behind the tool search counts>

uses.connector: <id, slug or name: approved, on, not broken>

uses.mailbox: <label, address or provider; empty: any of its own>

uses.site: <host, optional: never allowed yet → said on the card>

routine.schedule: routines.rs schedule (« every sunday at 19:00 », a cron…)
routine.ends: YYYY-MM-DD or a number of runs

watcher.ends: YYYY-MM-DD or a number of runs

task.budget: euros, optional: above the usual, said on the card

tool.refusal: Not done: missing <what> here; don't offer it. Nothing was made.

family_rule: its first use's (tool_kinds.rs for a tool); a browser, a search or other with « pay » later: shopping
never_rule: these tools as a use: refused (« … is never the offer itself … put « pay » in later »); a later step never granted by the offer's « Oui »

bip_offer_adds.uses_text: « Avec : Garmin · une page · une routine chaque dimanche vers 19 h, jusqu'au 12/4 »
bip_offer_adds.site: a site never allowed or null
bip_offer_adds.site_text: « Il te demandera l'accès à {site}. » or null
bip_offer_adds.detail: what an app 1.1 shows under « i » (the prompt, the outside line first, the first card's hint last)

card.bip_detail: an app 1.0's « i »: the prompt, then uses_text, later_text, site_text, one a line (the outside line first, the first card's hint last)
card.notification: contracts/notifications card/offer: the question alone (« {question} »), never urgent

answers.once: one turn of the agent with exactly the prompt (contracts/offers); a routine the card showed starts with it (made with routine_schedule in that turn: the same rhythm, no later end, once, within 20 min): no card of its own; a watcher keeps its connector card; anything paying, sending, booking, deleting, sharing keeps its own card
answers.deny: counted for its family (two in a row, or 5 with under 20 % yes: quiet 30 days; its topic not again for 30 days)
answers.outside: an offer made while reading a message from outside grants no routine: its card is shown

passes.config: [proactive] passes_cap, tick_seconds, quiet_minutes, gap_hours, passes_per_day, min_messages, input_chars
passes.due: smart, the person's own agent, not on a model outside; new since its last pass: min_messages of the person in its own conversations or an event (a watcher's, trigger's, routine's report, a plan's moment, the next 7 days of the phone's calendar changed, the Carnet's dates changed); gap_hours since its last pass; passes_per_day at most; quiet_minutes with no turn; none of its cards waiting and the day's caps not reached; the day's budget left. The first look of an agent only marks where reading starts.
passes.budget: the day's budget = (passes_cap − what the month spent before today) ÷ the days left, today included − what today spent; reached: no pass that day, nothing said
passes.own_model: on the person's own model: 0 €, only while no turn runs on the place
passes.call: one call to [notebook] model at the agent's provider (its own model on the person's machine), no tools, instructions starting « You look back over », what is new between <<<DATA and DATA>>>; at most 2 candidates (the free form + conversation: c1, c2…)
passes.placed: the first candidate that passes the checks and the caps: a card at once in its conversation (else the main one), pushed, counted in the day's unasked cards

runs: records of this look: the same pre-filter, nothing forced

app_1_0: a smart offer is the generic card: bip_summary « Vie propose : Je te fais un plan d'entraînement jusqu'au semi ? », under « i » the prompt and the lines; Oui / Non; its keys and types those of a basic offer's card (bip_offer's own keys aside)

examples.site_text_fr: Il te demandera l’accès à www.example-semi.fr.
